questions.prompt: The Industrial Revolution began in which country?
questions.fact: Cheap coal, navigable rivers and a patent system are usually credited, though historians still argue over the weighting.

questions.prompt: Which gas makes up about 21 percent of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.fact: Almost all of it is biological in origin, produced over billions of years by photosynthesising organisms.

questions.prompt: Which country originated the sport of curling?

questions.prompt: Which TV series follows a group of survivors in a zombie apocalypse, based on a comic?
questions.fact: The source comic deliberately avoided explaining the cause of the outbreak, and the show largely kept that choice.

questions.fact: Early machines had none at all - each program had to manage the hardware itself, including reading its own input.
